content: Monkeypatching class methods for temporary tracing: save the raw function from the class (or __dict__), not a bound method from getattr/instance access; restore in finally or a context manager. wrapt docs warn that getattr on a class triggers the descriptor protocol and returns a function bound to None, so restore of that object fails. pytest MonkeyPatch and unittest.mock.patch undo on exit for the same reason. Common mistakes: patching inherited methods on the wrong class, forgetting restore after exceptions, listing generator results inside wrappers and returning copies.
